name: Positional Encoding Frequency Annealing
definition: A coarse-to-fine strategy that constrains Fourier positional encoding to low dimensions initially to suppress high-frequency artifacts and self-occlusions.
summary: Positional Encoding Frequency Annealing is a coarse-to-fine optimization strategy that dynamically masks high-frequency Fourier bands during early training to suppress artifacts and stabilize convergence in neural radiance fields.
